description: Turns raw LP-lock data into a forward calendar: each unlock with its date, the % of LP it frees, the locker (UNCX / Team Finance labelled), and days away — flagging imminent unlocks (<30 days). An LP unlock is a scheduled price event: the moment a rug becomes possible. For agents managing open positions.
name: token_unlock

checkedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the underlying reads were taken.
